note: Remediation from the issue (document only, NON-BINDING): fail loudly on a denyRead / denyWrite entry that is not a string — refuse to start, or at minimum warn naming the offending key and index. Silently discarding a security-relevant block is the one outcome that gives an operator no chance to notice.
